title: Gail and the Lighthouse That Lost Its Way
chineseTitle: 瑜瑜與迷失方向的燈塔

harbor.name: 安靜港口
harbor.caption: HARBOR
harbor.alt: 紙船與燈塔的安靜港口

lighthouse.name: 燈塔工作室
lighthouse.caption: LIGHTHOUSE
lighthouse.alt: 燈塔內的安全模型工作桌

pages.title: A tiny lighthouse
lines: A little lighthouse blinks.
pages.translation: 小燈塔閃了一下。

pages.title: The light path
lines: The light makes a path.
pages.translation: 光做出一條路。

pages.title: At the harbor
lines: Gail sees the harbor.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜看見港口。

pages.title: The wrong beam
lines: The light points away.
pages.translation: 光照錯方向了。

pages.title: Circling boats
lines: The boats go in circles.
pages.translation: 小船繞圈圈。

pages.title: Meet the keeper
lines: A keeper comes.
pages.translation: 守護員來了。

pages.title: Not just brighter
lines: More light is not the answer.
pages.translation: 加亮也不行。

pages.title: Check the glass
lines: Gail looks at the glass.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜看玻璃。

pages.title: A tilted lens
lines: The lens has moved.
pages.translation: 鏡片歪了。

pages.title: Follow the reflection
lines: The light hits the card.
pages.translation: 光照在卡片上。

pages.title: Mark an angle
lines: Gail sees the angle.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜看角度。

pages.title: One small turn
lines: Turn it a little.
pages.translation: 轉一點點。

pages.title: Still too far
lines: The beam misses.
pages.translation: 光還沒對準。

pages.title: Compare two marks
lines: The marks are different.
pages.translation: 兩個記號不同。

pages.title: The right direction
lines: The beam reaches the sea.
pages.translation: 光照到海面了。

pages.title: The real lighthouse
lines: The lighthouse shines steadily.
pages.translation: 燈塔穩定發亮。

pages.title: Boats come home
lines: The boats enter the harbor.
pages.translation: 小船進港了。

pages.title: Remember the mark
lines: The keeper saves the mark.
pages.translation: 守護員留下記號。

pages.title: The goodbye flash
lines: The model glows again.
pages.translation: 模型又發光了。

pages.title: Back in the bedroom
lines: Gail is home.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜回家了。

pages.title: A tiny lighthouse
lines: A tiny lighthouse model blinks beside Gail's bed.
pages.translation: 一座迷你燈塔在瑜瑜床邊閃光。

pages.title: The light path
lines: Its light spreads across the bedroom floor. Gail follows the glowing path.
pages.translation: 燈光沿著臥室地板延伸。瑜瑜跟著亮路走。

pages.title: At the harbor
lines: Gail steps into a quiet harbor. Paper boats float near the shore.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜走進安靜的港口。紙船漂在岸邊。

pages.title: The wrong beam
lines: The lighthouse beam shines toward a hill. It does not reach the water.
pages.translation: 燈塔光束照向山坡，沒有照到水面。

pages.title: Circling boats
lines: The paper boats circle near the harbor. Gail notices that they are not moving in.
pages.translation: 紙船在港口附近繞圈。瑜瑜發現它們沒有進港。

pages.title: Meet the keeper
lines: The lighthouse keeper meets Gail. He wants to find what changed.
pages.translation: 燈塔守護員遇見瑜瑜。他想找出哪裡改變了。

pages.title: Not just brighter
lines: The keeper makes the lamp brighter. The beam still points at the hill.
pages.translation: 守護員把燈調亮。光仍照向山坡。

pages.title: Check the glass
lines: Gail and the keeper check the clean glass. Nothing blocks the light.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜和守護員查看乾淨的玻璃。光沒有被擋住。

pages.title: A tilted lens
lines: A lens inside the safe display model is tilted. Gail sees where the beam goes.
pages.translation: 安全模型裡的鏡片歪了。瑜瑜看見光照向哪裡。

pages.title: Follow the reflection
lines: Gail follows the light on a white card. The reflection shows its path.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜沿著白卡上的光看。反射顯示光的路徑。

pages.title: Mark an angle
lines: The keeper marks the old angle on the model. Gail compares it with the sea.
pages.translation: 守護員在模型上標出舊角度。瑜瑜拿它與海面方向比較。

pages.title: One small turn
lines: Gail rotates the model lens a little. The light moves across the card.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜稍微轉動模型鏡片。光沿著卡片移動。

pages.title: Still too far
lines: The test beam now points past the harbor. Gail asks to try again.
pages.translation: 測試光束越過港口。瑜瑜想再試一次。

pages.title: Compare two marks
lines: Gail points to two marks on the card. The keeper sees the gap.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜指出卡片上的兩個記號。守護員看見差距。

pages.title: The right direction
lines: They adjust the model again. Its beam points across the water.
pages.translation: 他們再次調整模型。光束指向水面。

pages.title: The real lighthouse
lines: The keeper sets the real lens safely. The lighthouse gives a steady flash.
pages.translation: 守護員安全地調整真鏡片。燈塔穩定閃光。

pages.title: Boats come home
lines: The paper boats follow the signal. One by one, they reach the harbor.
pages.translation: 紙船跟著訊號，一艘接一艘進港。

pages.title: Remember the mark
lines: The keeper records the angle. Next time he can check it quickly.
pages.translation: 守護員記下角度，下次就能快速核對。

pages.title: The goodbye flash
lines: The keeper thanks Gail. The little model flashes and opens the path home.
pages.translation: 守護員謝謝瑜瑜。小模型閃光，打開回家的路。

pages.title: Back in the bedroom
lines: Gail sets the model by her bed. She remembers to look and test.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把模型放在床邊。她記得先觀察再測試。

chinese: 一座迷你燈塔在瑜瑜床邊閃光。
燈光沿著臥室地板延伸。瑜瑜跟著亮路走。
瑜瑜走進安靜的港口。紙船漂在岸邊。
燈塔光束照向山坡，沒有照到水面。
紙船在港口附近繞圈。瑜瑜發現它們沒有進港。
燈塔守護員遇見瑜瑜。他想找出哪裡改變了。
守護員把燈調亮。光仍照向山坡。
瑜瑜和守護員查看乾淨的玻璃。光沒有被擋住。
安全模型裡的鏡片歪了。瑜瑜看見光照向哪裡。
瑜瑜沿著白卡上的光看。反射顯示光的路徑。
守護員在模型上標出舊角度。瑜瑜拿它與海面方向比較。
瑜瑜稍微轉動模型鏡片。光沿著卡片移動。
測試光束越過港口。瑜瑜想再試一次。
瑜瑜指出卡片上的兩個記號。守護員看見差距。
他們再次調整模型。光束指向水面。
守護員安全地調整真鏡片。燈塔穩定閃光。
紙船跟著訊號，一艘接一艘進港。
守護員記下角度，下次就能快速核對。
守護員謝謝瑜瑜。小模型閃光，打開回家的路。
瑜瑜把模型放在床邊。她記得先觀察再測試。

pages.title: A tiny lighthouse
lines: A tiny lighthouse model blinks twice beside Gail's bed. She watches it pause before the next flash.
pages.translation: 一座迷你燈塔模型在瑜瑜床邊閃了兩下。她看見它停頓後才再次發亮。

pages.title: The light path
lines: The model's light traces a glowing path across the familiar bedroom floor. When it reaches the window, a doorway to the coast appears.
pages.translation: 模型的光沿著熟悉的臥室地板畫出亮路。光到達窗邊時，一道通往海岸的門出現了。

pages.title: At the harbor
lines: Gail arrives at a quiet harbor where small paper boats and a toy ship drift on calm water. A tall lighthouse stands beyond the stone wall.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜來到安靜的港口，小紙船與一艘玩具小船漂在平靜水面上。一座高燈塔立在石牆後。

pages.title: The wrong beam
lines: The lighthouse sends its bright beam toward an inland hill instead of across the sea. The boats cannot see the usual way into the harbor.
pages.translation: 燈塔明亮的光束照向內陸山坡，沒有照到海面。紙船看不見平常進港的方向。

pages.title: Circling boats
lines: Several paper boats circle safely in the sheltered water. Gail notices that each one turns before reaching the harbor entrance.
pages.translation: 幾艘紙船在避風水域安全地繞圈。瑜瑜發現它們每次到港口入口前都轉回去。

pages.title: Meet the keeper
lines: The adult lighthouse keeper joins Gail at the shore. He says the beacon was steady yesterday, so they begin by looking for what changed.
pages.translation: 一位成年燈塔守護員來到瑜瑜身邊。他說昨天的燈光還很穩定，於是兩人先找出哪裡改變了。

pages.title: Not just brighter
lines: The keeper tries a brighter setting, but the beam still lands on the hill. Gail sees that a dim or bright beam cannot fix the wrong direction.
pages.translation: 守護員試著把燈調亮，光束仍落在山坡。瑜瑜看見，無論光線暗或亮，都無法單靠亮度修正方向。

pages.title: Check the glass
lines: Gail checks the outer glass while the keeper inspects the lamp safely. The glass is clear, so a dirty window is not the cause.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜查看外側玻璃，守護員安全地檢查燈具。玻璃乾淨，因此不是髒窗擋住了光。

pages.title: A tilted lens
lines: The keeper shows Gail a small working model of the lighthouse lens. Its tilted lens bends the test beam toward the hill.
pages.translation: 守護員給瑜瑜看一個可操作的燈塔鏡片模型。傾斜的鏡片把測試光束導向山坡。

pages.title: Follow the reflection
lines: They place a white card beside the model and follow the reflected light. The bright patch makes the beam's path easy to see.
pages.translation: 兩人把白卡放在模型旁，沿著反射的光看。明亮的光斑讓光束走向變得清楚。

pages.title: Mark an angle
lines: The keeper marks the model's starting angle before changing anything. Gail compares that mark with the direction of the harbor entrance.
pages.translation: 守護員在調整前先標出模型原本的角度。瑜瑜拿這個記號對照港口入口的方向。

pages.title: One small turn
lines: With the keeper beside her, Gail rotates only the safe model lens a little. They watch the beam move across the card instead of changing several things at once.
pages.translation: 守護員在旁陪同，瑜瑜只稍微轉動安全模型的鏡片。他們看光束沿白卡移動，沒有同時改動多個地方。

pages.title: Still too far
lines: Their first test sends the beam beyond the harbor entrance. Gail does not call it finished; she compares the new position with the marked target.
pages.translation: 第一次測試讓光束越過港口入口。瑜瑜沒有急著說完成，而是把新位置與標出的目標比較。

pages.title: Compare two marks
lines: Gail places the first and second marks side by side. The distance between them shows how much the lens needs to turn back.
pages.translation: 瑜瑜把前後兩個記號並排看。記號之間的距離顯示鏡片還要轉回多少。

pages.title: The right direction
lines: They make one smaller adjustment and test again. This time the model beam crosses the water toward the harbor entrance.
pages.translation: 他們做了更小的調整，再測一次。這次模型光束越過水面，指向港口入口。

pages.title: The real lighthouse
lines: Using the tested mark, the keeper safely sets the real lighthouse lens. A steady flash now crosses the water where the boats can see it.
pages.translation: 守護員依測試記號安全地調整真正的燈塔鏡片。穩定的閃光越過水面，紙船都看得見。

pages.title: Boats come home
lines: The clear signal can guide the paper boats through the calm entrance. One by one, they reach the sheltered harbor without circling again.
pages.translation: 紙船沿著清楚的訊號穿過平靜入口。它們一艘接一艘進入避風港，不再繞圈。

pages.title: Remember the mark
lines: The keeper records the working angle and tests one more flash. Gail sees how a careful note can help them check the beacon next time.
pages.translation: 守護員記下有效的角度，又測了一次閃光。瑜瑜看見，仔細記錄能幫助下次檢查燈塔。

pages.title: The goodbye flash
lines: After the keeper thanks Gail, the tiny model flashes twice again. Its light scatters gently into a path back to her bedroom.
pages.translation: 守護員向瑜瑜道謝後，迷你模型再次閃兩下。柔和光點散開，形成通往她臥室的路。

pages.title: Back in the bedroom
lines: Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail sets the little lighthouse beside her bed. She remembers to observe, test one change, and check where the light goes.
pages.translation: 回到熟悉臥室，瑜瑜把小燈塔放在床邊。她記得先觀察、一次測一個改變，再確認光照到哪裡。
